subject: [video] WP09 note for the PSNR-floor ruling: the patterns are frozen high-frequency pictures
body:
WP09 is done and idle; final commit 613ceb9 (only gpu/video/vectors). Re-ran after the last STATUS edit: bash gpu/video/vectors/check_vectors.sh -> N2TEST WP09 PASS 152/152, du -sb gpu/video/vectors -> 182356.

Relevant to WP10's 82 PSNR failures: pan/static/noise/text are the frozen definitions from WP09's work package, not encoder bugs. 'pan' samples world(x,y)=((x*7)^(y*13)^((x*y)>>4))&255, which is full of hard edges; 'noise' is an LCG at full amplitude; 'static' is pan frame 0; 'text' is 16/235 blocks. The absolute floors in PLAN section 7 (QP<=26: 36 dB, <=32: 32, <=40: 27, else 22) are not attainable on those at QP40/51 by any conforming encoder, as WP10 measured with x264 (pan QP51 16.6-19.6, noise 13.4-16.2). I have added this to vectors/STATUS.json known_risks and dsh/workers/WP09/STATUS.md and did NOT change the pictures or their hashes. If you want a gentler pattern, it would have to be a new name/size (e.g. a low-frequency 'ramp' pattern) added alongside the frozen ones, not a silent change; say the word and I will add it with its own manifest entries and hashes. Otherwise WP10's relative floor proposal is the right lever.

No other open items from me: 152/152 checks, embedded header 12618 B under the 48 KiB budget, no data committed, no phone/iOS code. Standing by for review.
